dataset_provenance_audit.provenance_classification: Third-party balanced benchmark subset (50 REAL / 50 FAKE) from Google/Jigsaw DFD / FaceForensics++ benchmark distribution (angads24/deepfake-video repository)
dataset_provenance_audit.held_out_status: Near-domain evaluation subset from FaceForensics++ DFD component; not a private unreleased test set, but a fixed, balanced, non-training public test subset.

score_polarity_verified.baseline_vit: Higher score = More Fake (Inverted separation due to high-frequency spatial noise / false positive trap)
score_polarity_verified.gend_pe_l: Higher score = More Fake (Slight positive separation +0.0130, conservative spatial)
score_polarity_verified.lipforensics: Higher score = More Fake (Strong positive separation +0.3701, temporal speech dynamics)

reconciliation_notes.stage_4b_vs_6e: Stage 4B evaluated Baseline ViT and GenD on the exact same 100 DFD videos (benchmark_results.json). Stage 6E reuses those exact per-video predictions and adds LipForensics under identical evaluation conventions.
reconciliation_notes.stage_5_vs_6e: Stage 5 evaluated GenD and Baseline on a different dataset: DFDC (100 videos split into Calibration 50 and Test 50). Stage 6E focuses on the standardized DFD benchmark. The numbers are therefore intentionally distinct because the datasets are distinct.

leakage_and_duplicate_audit.duplicate_details: One duplicate video file pair exists in the real folder: '01__walking_and_outside_surprised.mp4' and '02__walking_and_outside_surprised.mp4' (identical SHA-256 hash). Both are labeled REAL (Class 0).
leakage_and_duplicate_audit.train_test_leakage: None within the benchmark suite; models evaluated using frozen pretrained weights without training or calibration on this 100-video set.
leakage_and_duplicate_audit.statistical_validity: The single duplicate real video has a negligible impact on metrics (1 out of 50 real videos). The benchmark legitimately and solidly supports the 3-way architectural comparison.

conclusion.category: B) Usable and directly comparable with clearly documented dataset limitations
conclusion.summary: Stage 6E benchmark execution is verified as mathematically exact, apples-to-apples aligned, score-polarity verified, and free of cross-class contamination. LipForensics achieves 0.7794 ROC-AUC (vs. 0.4548 for Baseline ViT and 0.4224 for GenD), demonstrating that 25-frame temporal mouth modeling successfully overcomes the spatial compression false-positive trap on video deepfakes.
